versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident camp of the Adventure West Council with family-style dining hall, set at the base of Black Mountain near Wheatland beside Medicine Bow National Forest. Offerings range from the Roaring Lion first-year program to high-adventure rock climbing, mountain boarding, and ATVs.
